title.zh: Microsoft Copilot Studio：定位、能力、落地路径与费用
title.en: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Positioning, Capabilities, Adoption & Pricing

summary.zh: 按 2026 年 11 月官方许可与 Credits 指南及 10 月末 Learn 文档刷新：三大 Harness（新增 Customer Conversation 预览）、Apps 托管运行时、推理模型缓存 Token 与 Computer Use 计费、Entra Agent ID 强制身份治理与五组可复算费用示例。
summary.en: Refreshed against the November 2026 Licensing & Credits Guides and late-October Learn docs: three harnesses (including Customer Conversation preview), Apps & Managed Runtime, reasoning-model prompt-cache and Computer Use billing, mandatory Entra Agent IDs, and five reproducible cost scenarios.
